props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the field's root.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The clear button's name. It defaults to the `searchField.clear` row of the locale dictionary, "Clear search" in English. The button shows while the field holds text. It is out of the tab order, since Escape clears from the input, and a press keeps focus, and on touch the on-screen keyboard, on the input.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting value of an uncontrolled field. A native form reset restores it.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The error message, rendered as `Field.Error` while the field is invalid: through `isInvalid`, its own constraint check, or an error `Form` holds under its `name`. Without it, the field shows that `Form` error or the browser's constraint message.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field, the input and the clear button.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid, with the invalid look.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Makes the input read-only, with the muted read-only fill. It disables the clear button, Escape no longer clears, and `onSubmit` no longer runs. Enter and Escape keep their native behavior, so Enter can submit a surrounding form and Escape can close an enclosing `Dialog`.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Makes the input required, so the browser's constraint check blocks an empty submit.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, rendered as `Field.Label`, which names the searchbox. Without it, name the field with `aria-label`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the input submits its text under. Inside a `Form`, the field shows the error the form holds under this name, and an edit or a clear removes it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the input's text on every edit and on a clear.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button or Escape empties the field. Escape empties a field that holds text and stops there, so a `Dialog` or `Sheet` around the field stays open. On an empty field, Escape reaches them and closes them as usual.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the value on a plain Enter, not on a held key's repeats or an Enter with Alt, Control, Meta or Shift. With it, no Enter in an editable field submits the surrounding form. Without it, Enter submits the form, as in any text input.

props.name: size
props.description: The control size of the field box, also written as `data-size`. `default` is the md control size, and `sm` the sm one. The clear button follows it.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, for a controlled field.
